description: Source files for the Big Board district shapes. The base file supplies every district; an override replaces one redrawn state's districts with its enacted 2026 plan. Registry states without an override are drawn on 119th Congress lines and flagged prior_boundaries.

base.plan: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary file, 119th Congress, 1:20,000,000

overrides.plan: Livingston Congressional Plan 3-2023, restored by the U.S. Supreme Court's June 2, 2026 order; U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2026 120th Congressional Districts (built 2026-09-27), checked against the Census 120th Congress block equivalency file
AB 604 congressional plan, put in effect by Proposition 50 (November 4, 2025); California Senate Elections and Constitutional Amendments Committee
EOGPCRP2026, enacted by HB 1-D, approved May 4, 2026 (Chapter 2026-229); Florida Senate
Act 2 of the 2026 Regular Session (SB 121), signed May 29, 2026; Louisiana Legislature
Session Law 2025-95 (S249), enacted October 22, 2025; North Carolina General Assembly

Ohio Redistricting Commission plan adopted October 31, 2025; U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2026 120th Congressional Districts (built 2026-09-27), checked against the Census 120th Congress block equivalency file

HB 7003, enacted in special session and signed May 7, 2026; U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2026 120th Congressional Districts (built 2026-09-27), checked against the Census 120th Congress block equivalency file
PLANC2333, enacted by the 89th Legislature, 2nd Called Session, 2025; Texas Legislative Council

overrides.note: The portal regenerates this zip on each export, so a fresh download will not match this hash; keep the cached copy or re-verify and update the hash.

not_found.note: Only PDF maps and block descriptions of the 2023 Livingston Congressional Plan 3-2023 are published; court exhibits require PACER sign-in.
The Ohio Redistricting Commission's October 31, 2025 plan download has a block assignment file and PDFs, no shapefile.
HB 7003 (signed May 7, 2026) is published only as PDF maps; the state GIS server still has the 2022 layer.
